SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Form 990 is reviewed by the Scout Executive and made available to the entire Board of Directors before it is submitted to the IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: In mid-March of each year, the written conflict of interest policy is reviewed by the Board of Directors after the annual election of officers and board members.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Compensation is determined by the Compensation and Benefits Committee and approved by the Board that follows the National Boy Scouts of America guidelines.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section C, Line 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Records are kept for public disclosure upon request in the administrative office, including the Council Annual Report, financial statements, and conflict of interest policy.
